pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with moderately sharp edge gradients. Patch geometry transitions from large, stable blocks on the upper neck and shoulder to smaller, more irregular and fragmented shapes on the lower posterior flank and leg.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored negative space. Junction nodes are frequent and well-defined, forming a stable topological graph with relatively uniform pathway thickness across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the mane. Individual hair clusters create a fine serrated edge against the background visible from the upper neck through the shoulder ridge.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized circular de-pigmented spot visible within a large dark patch at the base of the neck/shoulder junction.
